text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> oncall-team:NET triggered (sev2). Alert: Multiple customers reporting failed PrivateLink connections and high route churn in us-east-1. Autoscale warnings for dedicated pools.

alice (oncall): seeing errors from customer A and B. PrivateLink endpoints return 504 or TCP reset. SDK traces show connect_timeouts ~30s.

bob (network): confirmed BGP flaps on DX path to eqx-ashburn. We've got route withdraws for tgw attachments. Possible AZ fabric issue in us-east-1b.

carol (sre): customer impact matrix? Which customers are on PrivateLink vs VPC peering vs DX? Need urgent list to page account owners.

dave (support-tier2): customer A (acct-512) on PrivateLink in us-east-1b seeing 100% fail rate since 09:02 UTC. Customer B on VPC peering in same AZ reporting intermittent packet loss. Support ticket created: #SUP-8421.

alice (oncall): runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privatelink-failure (follow step 1: confirm endpoints, step 2: failover). I'm starting triage.

bob (network): quick checks I ran:
```
# show bgp summary
Neighbor        AS MsgRcvd MsgSent  TblVer  InQ OutQ  Up/Down State/PfxRcd
10.10.0.1      64512  12345  12346  100     0    0 00:28:09  > 0
```
We see frequent BGP NOTIFICATION from peer, reason: cease.

bob (network): traceroute from our NAT in us-east-1b -> customer PrivateLink IP shows hop 4 timeout repeatedly, other AZs (1a,1c) are fine.

alice (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) enable routing failover to us-east-1a PrivateLink endpoints for affected customers 2) add temporary traffic steering rule in the routing plane to avoid DX path if BGP unstable 3) notify customers of degraded connectivity. Anyone object?

carol (sre): do it. I'm on watch for autoscale/backpressure. Set TTL on route announcements low for quick rollback.

bob (network): executing change: updating route table to prefer endpoint-usa-east-1a for acct-512. Command: `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc --destination-cidr-block 10.80.0.0/16 --network-interface-id eni-abcdef` (dry-run first).

pd-bot: Alice acknowledged the page. Estimated time to remediate: 45m. Handoff required if not resolved in 60m.

dave (support-tier2): ping window results after reroute: customer A success rate 98% after steering to 1a. Customer B still has packet loss (VPC peering) — looks like cross AZ fabric.

alice (oncall): good. Opening a live incident on status.redwood.com. Updating incident summary: "us-east-1 networking: PrivateLink & peering degraded due to AZ fabric + BGP instability; partial customer impact; mitigations applied: traffic steering to alternate AZs, temporary DX path blackhole."

carol (sre): I see increased CPU on the dedicated pool in 1a due to burst. Safeguard: throttle back aggressive autoscale policies to avoid noisy neighbor problems.

bob (network): AWS support case opened (case 1234567890). They see packet drops in their fabric and are investigating the leaf switch in us-east-1b. Coordinating with NOC.

alice (oncall): customer comms draft: "We're investigating PrivateLink/VPN connectivity issues in us-east-1b. We've temporarily steered traffic to alternate endpoints while upstream provider investigates. Some customers may see higher latency or errors during failover. We'll update in 30 minutes." Approve? :eyes: :writing_hand:

dave (support-tier2): approve. Send to affected account owners and CC CS.

pd-bot: Reminder: Handoff in 50 minutes to night oncall (eve).

alice (oncall): prepping handoff notes: root cause unknown (AWS fabric + DX BGP flaps suspected). Mitigations in place: route steering, AWS case, support tickets for customers. TODOs for next shift: monitor BGP, confirm AWS fix, rollback steering after stability, postmortem.

bob (network): next steps from network side: request AWS provide switch-level debug, collect PCAPs on transit gateway, run `show ip bgp neighbors <peer>` every 2m, and set up static route for high-priority customers if BGP persists.

carol (sre): create an incident channel and invite legal/CS for any SLA exposure. I'll start a Zoom if AWS confirms hardware issue.

alice (oncall): creating incident channel #inc-1710000000. Inviting stakeholders.

(30 minutes later)

bob (network): AWS reports partial packet loss fixed on their side; BGP sessions are stable since 09:48 UTC. We are seeing no withdraws for last 10m.

dave (support-tier2): customers report restored connectivity, but rolling errors for a short period during failback. No data loss reported.

alice (oncall): rolling back temporary steering to return traffic to primary endpoints in 1b (graceful). Watch for flaps.

carol (sre): monitoring 30m after rollback. If stable, we'll close the incident and open a postmortem.

(closure)

alice (oncall): Incident status: RESOLVED. Start a postmortem; assign to bob. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1710000000-postmortem.

bob (network): ack. Will collect BGP logs, DX stats, and timeline.

incident-bot: Incident closed by alice (oncall). Duration: 58 minutes.
